# NNNN: Short decision title

## Context

The situation and constraints that forced a choice, with evidence cited.

## Decision

What we chose, stated in one or two sentences.

## Alternatives

- **Option A**: why it was not chosen.
- **Option B**: why it was not chosen.

## Consequences

What becomes easier, what becomes harder, and what we now have to live with.
